user.title: Create a to-do list synchronization pair
user.description: Synchronize any two compatible Home Assistant to-do lists. Todo List Sync is designed primarily for a local Home Assistant list paired with an Alexa Devices shopping/to-do list. The first synchronization is non-destructive and merges active items from both lists.

error.same_entity: Primary and secondary lists must be different.
error.unsupported_entity: This to-do list does not support create, update and delete operations.
error.entity_already_used: One of these to-do lists is already used by another Todo List Sync entry.

abort.already_configured: This synchronization pair is already configured.

init.title: Todo List Sync options
init.description: Safety verification is limited to a minimum of 30 minutes. Alexa Devices receives an optimized full-list refresh when Home Assistant exposes the compatible runtime helper; generic providers continue with their Home Assistant cache.

data.refresh_on_reconnect: Refresh the secondary provider after reconnect

configured_list_missing.title: Configured to-do list is missing
configured_list_missing.description: Todo List Sync cannot find the configured {side} entity `{entity_id}` for **{entry_title}**. Restore or recreate that Home Assistant to-do entity, or remove and recreate the synchronization pair. A temporary `unavailable` provider state does not create this Repair.
